h1: Krabi Airport to Koh Lanta by private minivan
lead: Door to door between Krabi Airport (KBV) and your hotel on Koh Lanta, both ways, in a minivan just for your group.

facts.label: Pickup and drop-off
facts.value: Krabi Airport (KBV) and your hotel on Koh Lanta

faq.q: Where does the driver meet me at Krabi Airport?
faq.a: In the arrivals hall. Your driver waits with a sign showing your name. Send your flight number with your request.

faq.q: Can I book the transfer back to Krabi Airport?
faq.a: Yes. Choose Koh Lanta to Krabi Airport in the form and add your hotel as the pickup, with your date and pickup time.

faq.q: How long is the drive from Krabi Airport to Koh Lanta?
faq.a: About 2 to 3 hours, depending on traffic.

legacyText.title: Krabi Airport to Koh Lanta Minivan Taxi | VIP Taxi Lanta
body: Give us your flight number and landing time, your hotel on Koh Lanta and the number of people. The team confirms the price on WhatsApp and the driver waits in the arrivals hall with a sign showing your name.
For the way back, choose Koh Lanta to Krabi Airport in the form and add your hotel as the pickup, with the time you want to leave.
